annotations.title: NY LLC publication price by county

description: Returns Cheap NY Publication's all-in price to complete New York LLC publication for an LLC in a given county, for a New York LLC or an out-of-state (foreign) LLC, with what the price includes. Two ways are priced: the LLC's county changed to Albany County, whose designated newspapers cost the least (the change is filed for the customer and included), or publishing directly in the LLC's own county. Optionally compares a second county. Accepts borough names (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Staten Island). Use for any cost question. If the user names a specific LLC, use lookup_new_york_llc instead.

county.description: The New York county or NYC borough where the LLC's office is on file, e.g. Kings, Manhattan, Westchester.

llc_type.description: domestic = formed in New York; foreign = formed in another state and registered in New York. Default domestic.
